capabilities: draw ink annotations on PDF pages with pen or touch
insert shapes (rectangle, ellipse, line, arrow) and erase strokes or pixels
insert blank, lined, grid, dotted, or Cornell pages and delete pages
flatten drawings permanently into the PDF
create automatic backups before structural page changes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; structural page changes can be auto-backed up before modification.
problem: Obsidian cannot write annotations into PDF files, so users must switch to external PDF apps to draw on or edit PDFs.

relations.evidence: This plugin is built using: - pdf-lib for PDF manipulation.

summary: PDF annotator that opens PDFs inside Obsidian and saves ink drawings, shapes, and page edits directly into the PDF file.
